entities.summary: Susumu Hirasawa (b. 1954-04-01, Katsushika) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Katsushika and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
